title: Return to stock of medication never dispensed
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.13, medication prepared for a prescription but never dispensed may be returned to stock under pharmacy policy and procedure, but it may not be returned to the manufacturer's stock bottle. It must remain in the original patient container or an appropriate container bearing required product-identifying information and the expiration date assigned when filled, with recall safeguards.
exam_relevance: Separates never-dispensed return-to-stock workflow from medication physically returned by a patient after dispensing.
common_confusions: Never-dispensed medication may qualify for return to stock, but not by pouring it back into the manufacturer's stock bottle.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
